ctx.x: And after that band broke up, then I come on back up in Harlem at the Victoria. I stayed there about two years. Then they decided they wanted to start to broadcast from there. So we went out about three months... No, I'd say in about six months we went out, and went on down to the Brickwood. That's right across the street from where the Savoy used to be. The Brickwood was at 140th Street and Lenox Avenue. And this guy who had the band at his studio... I think he broadcast once a week from the Victoria. Sam...I…
